text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Admire Groove—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she was looking at was a crane game 
filled with plushies themed after 
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Are you interested in this, by any chance?
Are you interested, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No. I was just remembering something 
from the past.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The people playing around with that... 
were very noisy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like a very fond memory. 
However, if she has a fun experience with 
a claw crane game, that might overwrite 
the impression.
choice_data_list:
Let's give it a try. It might be fun if we 
do!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that's what you want to do, be my 
guest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
